scope: All tracked repository paths plus explicit manifest targets, reviewed catalog families and statically identifiable active entry candidates.
goal: All real tests are framework-native definitions with discovery, selection, individual execution steps/assertions, lifecycle/cancellation, observations and evidence owned by the existing MLF framework after extensions. Opaque whole-script wrappers are transitional only; legacy entry commands eventually forward to native framework scenarios or retire after exact coverage parity.
counting_warning: Entry rows mix command facades, executable/fixture candidates, catalog families and authored leaf observations. They intentionally overlap and MUST NOT be summed as independent test executions; original coverage IDs/aliases/metrics define execution coverage.

notes: Archive/reference assets stay P0; independent oracle behavior migrates with P5 cases.
Policy fault-contract cases migrate at P3; CI profile dispatch/SDK tag and publication mocks close at P6.
Framework process/telemetry/resource capabilities migrate at P2; actual native and async case coverage closes at P4.
Concrete bootstrap/full qualification/prepared Port/fixed-point paths close at P5.
Final retirement of all independent selection/判定 paths is P7, regardless of initial migration phase.

phases.P0: Freeze exhaustive ownership, assets, oracles and baseline coverage; classify all unknowns.
phases.P2: Framework lifecycle, adapters, fixtures, plans, resources, capabilities, diagnostics and process ownership.
phases.P3: Core/Harness/ordinary cases, properties, negative contracts, source/CLI smoke and policy contracts.
phases.P6: SDK, benchmark/profiling, CI profiles and release-validation integration.
phases.P7: Retire unmanaged selectors/assertions; legacy launchers only forward to framework; exact coverage audit closes every pending row.

limitations_and_acceptance_blockers: Static candidates are an exhaustive review queue, not a claim every script/program is a test.
All static-candidate-needs-owner-review rows must be assigned to a reviewed test adapter or documented support/side-effect-only role before declaring migration complete.
Dynamic/generated entries and native probe modes require semantic owner review; the current full family/golden inventory is embedded to prevent loss of interior assertions.
Missing literal references never justify deletion; manifests, imports, generated names, historical references and external consumers may own the asset.
Publication and installation are not tests and must remain separately authorized effects; mocked/offline policy and SDK validation are managed test scenarios.
Matrix/campaign engines need not share the small in-process Case execution mechanism, but all real tests must use framework discovery, selection, scheduling, reports and evidence.
